briefings.title: The Iran War Crisis: Ex-CIA Analyst Helima Croft on Oil Shock & Energy Risk | The Weekly Wrap

people.name: Helima Croft
people.role: Global Head of Commodity Strategy, RBC

briefings.tldr: The conflict with Iran has effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz, causing a massive 6.7 million barrel-per-day "shut-in" of Middle Eastern oil; if military operations extend beyond two weeks, the global economic ramifications could be catastrophic.
